entry.name: displayedText
entry.label: The text to show inside the desktop rectangles.

entry.name: showWindowIcons
entry.label: Whether to show window icons inside the window rectangles.

entry.name: overflowMargin
entry.label: Width of the empty area reserved on each side of a desktop, in desktop widths, for windows scrolled out of view.

entry.name: fadeStart
entry.label: Fraction of the reserved area next to the viewport that stays fully opaque before off-screen window outlines start to fade.

entry.name: fadeExponent
entry.label: Shape of the fade curve for off-screen window outlines. 1 is linear, larger values fade more aggressively.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentScreen
entry.label: Whether to limit the Pager to the set of windows and the geometry of the screen the widget resides on.

entry.name: wrapPage
entry.label: Whether to wrap page when navigating with pager

entry.name: currentDesktopSelected
entry.label: What to do on left-mouse click on a desktop rectangle.

entry.name: pagerLayout
entry.label: The layout style used for the presentation.
